subject: Vendr access curation & rotation playbook — Helio Research profile
messages:
From: Vendr Portal Team <onboarding@vendr.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr onboarding: access curation & rotation playbook for Helio Research

Hi Priyom / Mina / Marissa,

Thanks for choosing Vendr for the Helio Research security profile. As part of our portal on-boarding we need to validate who will own portal duties and how short-lived credentials / evidence rotation will be managed. To speed things up, I attached a short playbook (vendr_onboarding_instructions.pdf) and an access matrix template.

Requests:
- Confirm 1 primary profile owner and 1 backup who can sign submissions and rotate credentials.
- Provide a list of any service accounts or S3 buckets that Vendr will need to reference in evidence (object paths only).
- Confirm whether your team prefers ephemeral creds (STS) or static service principals for API ingest and which rotation cadence you enforce.
- If you have an existing CAIQ mapping we can import, attach it; otherwise we included a CAIQ mapping template to fill.

Notes: the portal supports delegated uploads (S3 presigned) and API-based ingest. If you select API ingest with short-lived tokens, uploads will expire after the token TTL — our default recommendation is 1 hour.

Quick next steps:
1) Reply with profile owner names and the preferred credential model.
2) We'll provision a temporary writer account for the owner for 7 days to do a first-pass import.

Attachment stubs: [vendr_onboarding_instructions.pdf (3 pages)], [vendr_access_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [caiaq-mapping-template.csv]

— Ellen Kim
Onboarding Lead, Vendr
onboarding@vendr.io

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Vendr Portal Team <onboarding@vendr.io>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: access curation & rotation playbook for Helio Research

Ellen — thanks, sending this to our internal security and product leads for signoff. Answers below; see inline where applicable.

Profile owners:
- Primary: Mina Haddad (Security Lead)
- Backup: Marissa Cole (Vendor Ops Manager)

Service accounts / buckets:
- artifactory-evidence (s3://redwood-evidence/artifactory/helio) — used for automated evidence exports
- telemetry-logs (s3://redwood-telemetry/helio) — contains scrubbed traces used in our SIG mapping

Credential model: we prefer ephemeral STS-style tokens for uploads and API ingest. Our security policy requires rotation <= 2 hours for any token that can perform writes to vendor portals. Static keys are only allowed for read-only purposes and must be rotated every 90 days.

CAIQ: we do not have a completed CAIQ export for Helio; Aditya will coordinate a short mapping with your template.

Questions:
1) When you provision the temporary writer account, will that be scoped to a specific org/tenant in Vendr, or is it cross-tenant?
2) For S3 presigned uploads, can you accept multipart uploads and a manifest file (we produce Manifests for large evidence batches)?

We'll attach a filled access matrix and the first-pass CAIQ mapping by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Priyom
Sr. Vendor Risk, Redwood Inference

From: Vendr Portal Team <onboarding@vendr.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 18:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: access curation & rotation playbook for Helio Research

Thanks Priyom — great detail, appreciate it. Quick answers inline: 

- Temporary writer account: tenant-scoped to Helio Research org only (we create a scoped role and a single-tenant API key). We'll provision it for 7 days and you can escalate for extension via the portal.
- Multipart uploads & manifests: supported. Our presigned upload endpoint accepts multipart; include the manifest.json alongside the parts. We also accept a zipped evidence bundle if that's simpler.

We recommend the following changes to match our ingest best practices:
- Use a 1-hour TTL for STS tokens used for writer uploads (matches our default); your 2-hour policy is OK but results in a slightly larger vulnerability window — would you be open to 1 hour for writer-level tokens and 4 hours for read-only API tokens?
- For S3 presigned multipart, include an additional header x-vendr-manifest-hash to allow us to validate the manifest prior to reassembly.

Attachment: I uploaded a filled example vendr_access_matrix.xlsx with a sample of how Helio artifacts should be named. Also linking the profile URL for quick review: https://app.vendr.io/portal/helio-research/profile/ABCDEFG

If Mina can confirm the 1-hour writer TTL and Aditya can drop the CAIQ mapping into the CSV, we can start the temporary writer provisioning tomorrow morning.

— Ellen
Vendr Onboarding

(Quoted from Priyom Das):
> Ellen — thanks, sending this to our internal security and product leads for signoff. Answers below; see inline where applicable.

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Kim <ellen.kim@vendr.io>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Jun 2027 01:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: access curation & rotation playbook for Helio Research

Ellen / team — we can accept the 1-hour writer TTL as a compromise. Please scope the temporary writer strictly to the Helio org and disable lateral access. A couple of operational asks before we proceed: 

1) Please provide a short checklist for what you will validate during the 7-day import window so our team can be available for troubleshooting (e.g., manifest schema errors, missing proof-of-possession headers, CAIQ field mapping mismatches).
2) We will submit S3 paths and an initial manifest by 09:00 PT tomorrow. If you could enable multipart upload and the x-vendr-manifest-hash header enforcement for that window, we will use it.
3) Requesting a signed evidence ingestion SLA for the import window only (upload success rate and retry behavior). If you have a short doc we can sign, attach it to the portal record or share a link.

Attachment: I have uploaded the access matrix + partial CAIQ mapping to the HubSpot case (HUBSPOT-CASE-67892) and attached a sanitized manifest example to the case.

Once we confirm the scaffolding tomorrow, Marissa will coordinate the actual upload.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
